definition: הַס , הָ֑ס interjection hush! keep silence (probably onomatopoetic) Judg 3:19 and he said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king, וַיּאֹמֶר הָ֔ס and he said, Keep silence! Amos 6:10 וְאָמַר הָ֔ס (while burying men in a pestilence), Amos 8:3 (elliptical) in every place: הִשְׁלִיךְ הָֽס they cast them (the corpses) forth, (saying) Hysh ! followed by ׳ (מִפָּנָיו) מִפְּנֵי י Hab 2:20 ; Zeph 1:7 ; Zech 2:17 . Inflected, as though a verb, imperative plural הַ֔סּוּ Neh 8:11 ( Ges compares Arabic [= הֲלֹם ] hither! inflected as an imperative, e.g. , : W AG i. § 368 ). Hence as denominative Hiph`il imperfect with apocope וַיַּ֫הַס Num 13:30 and Caleb stilled the people. הֲפֻגָה see below פוג .
